issues.description: Method return-type mismatch for SealSaloon.orderMeal(Meal): The problem statement UML and textual description declare SealSaloon.orderMeal(Meal) with return type void (problem_statement.md line 31). The solution implementation defines the method as public boolean orderMeal(Meal meal) (src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java line 12). This inconsistency can confuse students about the required signature and lead to mismatches between student implementations, reference solution behavior, and automated tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent. Preferred fix: change the solution implementation to match the specification by declaring the method as public void orderMeal(Meal meal) and remove the boolean return value and any return statements that return true/false. Alternative (less desirable): update the problem statement/UML and tests to document that orderMeal returns boolean and adjust the description so students are aware of the boolean return value. Prefer keeping the specification (void) to match the UML and exercise instructions.
